product.description: A configurable pipeline builder that automates document ingestion, structured data extraction, and integration with databases or retrieval systems.

product.name: Quick and Secure Integration
product.description: A hosted API deployment enabling rapid integration of Pulse’s document extraction capabilities with enterprise-grade security and compliance.
